reuse: docs 'Emblems', 'Planeswalker statics, eminence and loyalty timing' (ADR 0140), game/emblem.go, loyalty_limit.go; static on a planeswalker (Tezzeret's 'first activated ability of an artifact you activate each turn costs {2} less': game/activated.go:2698 first-activation record + cost_modifier.go; Nissa's Forest mana trigger: mana_trigger.go; Professor Onyx's magecraft: Magecraft()); 'target opponent gets an emblem': chandra_awakened_inferno.go; emblem alt cost (Tamiyo): GrantedAltCostFree; 'until your next turn, whenever …' (Tamiyo +1): jace_reality_sculptor.go, garruk_curse_breaker.go; land animation with counters (Nissa +1): manland precedents; Wolf tokens with a dies trigger (Garruk) and '*/* Treefolk with reach' (Wrenn and Seven) are new tokens only here; 'repeat this process six more times' (Onyx -8) is a loop of keyed per-opponent choices; Liliana, Death Wielder uses plain -1/-1 counters. Grist is a seam card (s4), not here.

cards.name: Nissa, Who Shakes the World
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you tap a Forest for mana, add an additional {G}.
+1: Put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target noncreature land you control. Untap it. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with vigilance and haste that's still a land.
−8: You get an emblem with "Lands you control have indestructible." Search your library for any number of Forest cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Professor Onyx
cards.oracle_text:
Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
+1: You lose 1 life. Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
−3: Each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls.
